say:0:1029127001:0.text: AH!! It's heading straight for us! What are we gonna do?
say:0:1029127001:0.source_cn: 呜呜啊啊啊——它朝我们过来了！怎么办，该往那边逃跑才可以……

say:1:1029127002:0.text: Look out, boss! It's going towards you!
say:1:1029127002:0.source_cn: 老大，小心！那家伙向你扑过去了！

say:2:1029127003:0.text: How can it be so fast?! AHHHH!
say:2:1029127003:0.source_cn: 啊啊啊啊！这东西怎么这么快！我的对恶魔特技呢，看招——

say:3:1029127004:0.text: Learned your lesson then? Don't worry, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> helped block its attack.

say:4:1029127005:0.source_cn: 这些孩子应该已经受到教训了。我们先魔物处理掉吧。
